companionBriefing: Portia only lets in people who greet her properly. Answer in Spanish; mixing in English is fine while you learn.
Tap a word under her line to see what it means, or Translate sentence for the whole line. On her newest line each one uses a hint from my allowance.
The words and phrases shown beneath her lines go into your Spellbook, where you can review them later.

steps.name: move to the_rift (expect NOT_ADJACENT)
steps.message: You can't get to The Rift from here.

steps.name: say "¡Hola!"
steps.feedback: Good greeting! Now introduce yourself and ask Portia her name in Spanish.

steps.name: say "Me llamo Sam."
steps.feedback: Your introduction is correct. Now ask Portia her name in return in Spanish.

lines.native: Hola. ¿Quién eres? Your greeting and name, please. We have standards. Also, a ledger.
lines.translation: Hello. Who are you? Your greeting and name, please. We have standards. Also, a ledger.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the archway’s keystone. Apparently, even entrances have paperwork.

lines.native: ¡Hola! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, however, remains unfiled. ¿Quién eres?
lines.translation: Hello! Your greeting is accepted. Your name, however, remains unfiled. Who are you?
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides out of Portia’s keystone. The space for your name remains pointedly empty.

lines.native: Mucho gusto, Sam. Your introduction is officially filed. Now, ¿tienes una pregunta para mí? I am more than load-bearing infrastructure, you know.
lines.translation: Nice to meet you, Sam. Your introduction is officially filed. Now, do you have a question for me? I am more than load-bearing infrastructure, you know.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book opens in Portia’s keystone. She records Sam with the solemnity normally reserved for international borders, then leaves a conspicuous blank beside her own entry.

lines.native: ¿Yo? Me llamo Portia. Mucho gusto, Sam. How considerate. Your paperwork is complete; you may enter the market. I shall record this as a conversation. Rather than a traffic incident.
lines.translation: Me? My name is Portia. Nice to meet you, Sam. How considerate. Your paperwork is complete; you may enter the market. I shall record this as a conversation. Rather than a traffic incident.
lines.narrative: A visitors’ book slides from the keystone. Portia turns to her own entry with the flustered dignity of an official unexpectedly counted as a person.
